_comment: Jetson Orin Nano Super site edge node. Aggregation plus on-site training.
_device_id_note: Truncated to 64 bits on encode. Keep it under 16 hex digits.
_queue_note: 2M frames x 300 B = 600 MB. On an Orin with NVMe that is nothing, and it is 4.5 years of a 50-node site -- which is the point of training here: the history never has to leave.

scorer._kind_note: Measured at 5 us/frame batched. The GPU has no job on this path; see tools/workload_study.py for the three candidates it was tested against.

training._note: On-site training is the one justification for this board that survived the workload study. No frame leaves the site.

channels.name: edge_self
channels._note: No sensor of its own; present so --self-test exercises the full path.
